messages:
Rina: Heads-up: GA tomorrow morning. We're triaging final acceptance criteria. Minimal checklist I propose: customer-facing SLA doc, commercial pilot T&Cs, NOC playbook (runbooks + rollback cmds), alerting + dashboards, cost controls for pilots, and a short customer comms draft. Who picks what?
Omar: I'll own SLA doc and compact SLI table. Suggest p99 availability 99.5 for pilot, p95 latency target 800ms.
Ben: I'll do pilot cost controls and the FAQ for overages/credits. There's a feature flag `pilot_billing_cap` we can use.
Claire: NOC playbook + rollback commands. I want explicit play steps for partial degradation (route to lightweight model) and hard rollback. Example command I will add:
```
# route traffic to fallback
redwoodctl traffic set --service inference --variant light-quant
```
ops-bot: scheduled smoke job `ga-preflight-1860` for 2025-07-01T05:30:00Z. Will post pass/fail.
Rina: Also need a 1-paragraph comms note for commercial to send to pilots outlining expectations and support windows. Ben can you draft?
Ben: Will draft FAQ + comms blurb. ETA 16:00 PT.
Omar: SLA draft link: https://docs.internal/sla/ga-lite. Contains SLOs, remediation steps (rollback-first), and credit policy stub.
Claire: Runbook PR includes the fallback curl and a checklist for oncall. Adding a short verification script for rollback success.
ops-bot: ga-preflight-1860 completed: PASS. telemetry_checks=ok alert_routing=ok logs=https://logs.redwood/1860
Rina: Great. Owners summary: Omar (SLA), Ben (commercial/FAQ), Claire (runbook/NOC), Rina (release greenlight + notify legal). If all merged by 16:30 PT -> green. If anything slips mark amber and convene shiproom.
Ben: Noted. I'll ping when FAQ lands.
Omar: I'll merge SLA once Claire's rollback snippets are in.
Rina: Thanks team — final status posted at 16:35 PT to #all-hands. Good luck.
